StageAttention: A monster created by the fusion of the Unknown Lifeform from the Red Tide and the Construct Chiko. Chiko, who maintains partial control within its chaotic core, drives this newborn body toward the ending she had foreseen.
Chiko uses her dual blades to strike her surrounding area with continuous slashes, slowing the targets within the area.
Chiko tears through the void, summoning tentacles from within to attack the targets.
Chiko charges before expanding a field, summoning meteors that fall randomly within the area.
Chiko attacks the target ceaselessly with throwing knives, which can be parried.
Chiko summons two water tornadoes around her, pulling in the target meanwhile. Then, she combines the water tornadoes to attack the target, dealing Slash DMG multiple times on hit.
Chiko slashes the target three times in a row with dual blades. These slashes can be parried. Three successful parries will paralyze Chiko temporarily.
Chiko submerges and hunts like a shark, attacking the target meanwhile. The attack can be parried.
Leaping backward, Chiko combines her dual blades into a giant claw before charging at the target with slashing strikes and a downward slam. This attack can be parried.
Chiko combines her dual blades and throws them at the target. As the blades approach the target, water splashes will expand, forming a water dungeon that restricts the target.
Chiko turns her back to the target, blocking the incoming attack and then turning around to counterattack. The counterattack can be parried. Two successful parries will paralyze Chiko temporarily.
